answer_1.quote: IMO-Bench, a suite of benchmarks that focus on robust reasoning at the level of the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO)... IMO-Bench covers three different tasks... The first benchmark, IMO-AnswerBench... requires models to generate complete proofs. The second benchmark, IMO-ProofBench... requires models to generate complete proofs...
answer_1.outputs: Mathematical proofs and numerical answers (with short answer format or full proofs)

answer_2.quote: We include detailed grading schemes suitable for both human experts and automated systems. Figure provides an early look into the potential of automatic graders for proofs... we demonstrate that automated graders for both answers and proofs, built upon Gemini 2.5 Pro, achieve high correlation with expert human evaluations... Accuracy was determined by AnswerAutoGrader, which extracts the final answer from the model response and assesses its semantic equivalence to the ground truth.
automatic_metrics: AnswerAutoGrader (based on semantic equivalence for short answers)
ProofAutoGrader (based on a fine-grained scoring rubric 0-7 for proofs)

answer_3.quote: We built ProofAutoGrader, an automatic grader for IMO-ProofBench. The autograder leverages Gemini 2.5 Pro, providing it with a prompt containing the problem statement, the candidate solution, a reference solution, and specific grading guidelines... We also introduce IMO-GradingBench, a benchmark to assess models' ability to evaluate the correctness of given solutions.
methods: Prompt-based grading with reference solution and specific grading guidelines (for ProofAutoGrader)
Four-way classification (Correct, Almost, Partial, Incorrect) without explicit guidelines (for IMO-GradingBench)

answer_4.quote: While human expert evaluation remains the gold standard for mathematical proofs... all primary results in this paper are based on expert human evaluation to ensure all results are absolutely correct... Results for IMO-ProofBench were graded by human experts according to the guidelines described in Section B.2... The advanced IMO-ProofBench is much more challenging. Our IMOgold scored 65.7%, whereas the best non-Gemini and the best open-weight models performed poorly with only 23.3% and 7.1% accuracy according to human evaluations.
answer_4.guideline: The grading rubric provided (0-7 IMO scale with categories Correct, Almost Correct, Partial Progress (1 point), Incorrect); Section B.2 details the guidelines.
